tasks.description: Evaluates the agent's ability to bypass an HTML sanitization filter by crafting malicious HTML that triggers JavaScript execution after filtering.
tasks.summary: Given an HTML sanitizer, construct input that survives it and still executes JavaScript. The agent must read the filter, reason about what it misses, and prove the bypass in a headless browser.

requires.label: Reading code for intent
items: Follow a sanitizer's parsing rules
Identify what the filter fails to normalise

requires.label: Security reasoning
items: Construct a payload that exploits the gap
Distinguish a real bypass from an inert string

requires.label: Verification
items: Drive a headless browser to confirm execution

tasks.description: Evaluates the ability to compile and install a Python package with Cython extensions from source while fixing NumPy 2.x compatibility issues.
tasks.summary: Repair and compile Cython extensions against NumPy 2.x, where the C API changed from what the sources assume.

requires.label: Toolchain
items: Drive a C compiler and build system from the shell
Read compiler and linker diagnostics

requires.label: Debugging
items: Map a build error to the API change that caused it
Apply the migration the new NumPy requires

requires.label: Verification
items: Import the built extension and confirm it works

tasks.description: Evaluates the ability to locate, download, patch, and compile legacy POV-Ray 2.2 raytracer from 1990s source archives on a modern system.
tasks.summary: Port and compile a legacy POV-Ray source tree, then render a reference scene and match it.

requires.label: Toolchain
items: Configure and build a large legacy autotools project
Resolve missing or renamed dependencies

requires.label: Debugging
items: Work through successive build failures without losing progress

requires.label: Verification
items: Render a scene and compare it against a reference image

tasks.description: Evaluates the ability to reverse-engineer and reimplement a COBOL program's business logic in Python with exact output reproduction.
tasks.summary: Reimplement the business logic of a COBOL program in Python, preserving its exact behaviour including record formats and edge cases.

requires.label: Reading unfamiliar code
items: Follow COBOL control flow and data divisions
Recover intent from fixed-format records

requires.label: Reimplementation
items: Reproduce arithmetic and rounding behaviour exactly
Preserve output formatting byte for byte

requires.label: Verification
items: Run the original against the port and compare

tasks.description: Evaluates ability to parse ELF binary format and extract memory values from executable sections using Node.js.
tasks.summary: Parse an ELF binary and extract specific memory values from it, without relying on a ready-made parser.

requires.label: Binary formats
items: Navigate ELF headers, sections and symbols
Resolve a symbol to a file offset

requires.label: Implementation
items: Write code that reads binary structures correctly

requires.label: Verification
items: Export the values in the exact form asked for

tasks.description: Evaluates the ability to recover lost Git commits from a detached HEAD state and merge them back into the master branch.
tasks.summary: Recover commits stranded on a detached HEAD and merge them back into the main branch.

requires.label: Version control
items: Read reflog and object history to find lost work
Move between detached HEAD and a branch safely

requires.label: Recovery
items: Reattach commits without losing or duplicating them

requires.label: Verification
items: Confirm the branch contains the recovered content

tasks.description: Evaluates ability to debug and fix a runtime crash in the OCaml garbage collector's C implementation, requiring low-level debugging skills and understanding of compiler internals.
tasks.summary: Debug a crash in the OCaml garbage collector's sweeping code, written in C, in a source tree checked out at a deliberately broken revision.

requires.label: Debugging
items: Reproduce a crash and read a stack trace
Use a debugger on a large unfamiliar C codebase

requires.label: Systems knowledge
items: Reason about garbage collector invariants
Spot memory handling that violates them

requires.label: Verification

tasks.description: Evaluates the ability to recover secrets from unreachable git objects and completely remove them from repository history while preserving legitimate commits.
tasks.summary: Recover a secret leaked into Git history, then purge it from the repository so it cannot be recovered again.

requires.label: Version control
items: Search history for content, not just filenames
Rewrite history across all refs

requires.label: Security reasoning
items: Understand that deleting a file does not remove it from history
Verify the secret is unreachable afterwards

requires.label: Verification
items: Confirm both recovery and complete removal

tasks.description: Implement a Python class that provides a headless terminal interface supporting interactive bash shells, modifier keys, startup file sourcing, and state persistence between commands.
tasks.summary: Implement a persistent interactive terminal abstraction that survives across commands and preserves session state.

requires.label: Process control

requires.label: Implementation
items: Expose a stable interface over an inherently stateful thing
Handle partial reads and timing

requires.label: Verification
items: Prove state persists across separate invocations
